GST Payment Request (GPR)
A request, raised on a Work Order, to pay the vendor the GST part. An Accountant approves or rejects it on Project Payment & Expense › GST Requests.
GST Payment Approved bell
The for-information notification every Admin gets when an approved GST request creates its payment.
Pill
The small status buttons above the GST Requests list: Pending, Approved, Paid, Rejected, All.
Reviewed column
On GST Requests: who approved or rejected the request, and when. Shown on every pill but Pending.
Broken mid-word
A word or ID split across two lines by a column that is too narrow, e.g. "SR-00092-00081" over "4". The walk reads every cell of the table for it.
Audit View
A Reports tab for Admin and the Accountants: pick a date range (step 1), then Orders, Invoices or Payments (step 2).
Report Type
Audit View's picker: Projects Data (orders, invoices and payments of projects) or Non Projects Data (company-level expenses).
Record name
The short id the app gives an expense, such as r6n13vklrg. The Against column shows the expense's description instead.
Cheque Tracker
The list of every cheque, by status; a vendor's page has the same list, narrowed to that vendor, under Cheques.
Reimbursement (claim)
Money a person spent for work and asks to be paid back, on the Reimbursements page.
Payment need to be paid
The Reimbursements tab of fully approved claims waiting for Accounts to pay. It opens on this month.
Badge
The number beside a tab's name.
Reconciliation Pending
Marked paid, but the bank reference (UTR) and proof are still to be added. Mark Reconciled adds them.
Pay dialog
The dialog Mark Reconciled opens for a Project or Non-Project Expense: payment receipt, reference and date.
